#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only receipt review and complete paired analysis; never runs product code."""
import collections
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import statistics
import sys

BASE = Path("/workspace/scratch/bfccb8494ba0")
INTAKE = BASE / "round30-PR190-equal-lifetime-original-intake"
RAW = INTAKE / "extracted"
CONTEXT = BASE / "round29-PR190-equal-lifetime-recovery/restored"
OUT = BASE / "round30-PR190-equal-lifetime-independent-review"
G = "f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a"
TREE = "4d49ddd5e61b9b32f2677a9966c3326c336aec0e"
CASES = ["multiple_text", "short_fields", "blob", "empty_text", "null"]
SCHEMA = "p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-v1"
WORKFLOW = ".github/workflows/p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost.yml"
TEST = "benchmark::oracle::projection_tests::borrowed_serialization_equal_lifetime_release_cost_probe"
ARGV = ["cargo", "test", "--release", "--locked", "--message-format=json", "-p",
        "cc-eval", "--lib", TEST, "--", "--exact", "--ignored", "--nocapture", "--test-threads=1"]
SCOPE_STRINGS = {
    "timing_scope": "same SQLite SELECT traversal plus row serialization and output retention; verification, hash and output drop excluded",
    "output_lifetime": "one immutable shared reference; each side output verified, hashed and dropped before next side timing",
    "order_limit": "alternating order retained; allocator and cache history not reset or claimed eliminated",
    "comparison_protocol": "independent equal-lifetime observation; not a rerun or correction of the v1 retained-pair probe",
}
EXPECTED_FILES = {"Cargo.lock", "cargo-after.txt", "cargo-before.txt", "cost-observation.json",
                  "execution.json", "identity-after.json", "identity-before.json", "probe.stderr",
                  "probe.stdout", "rustc-after.txt", "rustc-before.txt", "source-after.json", "source-before.json"}

def jload(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

def file_record(path):
    b = path.read_bytes()
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": len(b), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
            "git_blob": hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(b)).encode() + b"\0" + b).hexdigest()}

def jbytes(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()

def write_new(name, value):
    b = jbytes(value)
    with (OUT / name).open("xb") as f:
        f.write(b)

def parse_stream(raw):
    records, artifacts, finishes = [], [], []
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        start = line.find("{")
        if start < 0:
            continue
        try:
            value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(line[start:])
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            continue
        if value.get("schema") == SCHEMA:
            assert not line[start + end:].strip()
            records.append(value)
        elif start == 0:
            if value.get("reason") == "build-finished":
                finishes.append(value)
            if (value.get("reason") == "compiler-artifact"
                    and value.get("target", {}).get("name") == "cc_eval"
                    and value.get("target", {}).get("kind") == ["lib"]
                    and value.get("profile", {}).get("test") is True and value.get("executable")):
                artifacts.append(value)
    return records, artifacts, finishes

def describe(values):
    s = sorted(values)
    n = len(s)
    return {"n": n, "min": s[0], "q1_median_lower_half": statistics.median(s[:n//2]),
            "median": statistics.median(s), "q3_median_upper_half": statistics.median(s[(n+1)//2:]),
            "max": s[-1], "all_sorted": s}

def paired_summary(rows):
    ratios = [r["borrowed_over_original"] for r in rows]
    assert all(x is not None for x in ratios), "Observed denominator is zero: ratio analysis requires explicit handling."
    return {"n": len(rows),
            "borrowed_faster": sum(r["borrowed_ns"] < r["original_ns"] for r in rows),
            "borrowed_slower": sum(r["borrowed_ns"] > r["original_ns"] for r in rows),
            "equal": sum(r["borrowed_ns"] == r["original_ns"] for r in rows),
            "ratio_borrowed_over_original": describe(ratios),
            "paired_time_change_percent": describe([100 * (x - 1) for x in ratios]),
            "original_ns": describe([r["original_ns"] for r in rows]),
            "borrowed_ns": describe([r["borrowed_ns"] for r in rows]),
            "sum_borrowed_over_sum_original_descriptive_only":
                sum(r["borrowed_ns"] for r in rows) / sum(r["original_ns"] for r in rows),
            "pair_rounds_in_original_order": [r["round"] for r in rows]}

def main():
    started = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    files = sorted(p for p in RAW.iterdir() if p.is_file())
    assert set(p.name for p in files) == EXPECTED_FILES and len(files) == 13
    source_proof = CONTEXT / "equal-lifetime-admission/private-view-actual-source-proof.json"
    source_path = CONTEXT / "equal-lifetime-candidate/crates/cc-eval/src/benchmark/oracle.rs"
    workflow_path = CONTEXT / "equal-lifetime-candidate" / WORKFLOW
    driver_path = BASE / "GW4-original-build-intake/source-observers/scripts/p7_build_identity.py"
    official_path = BASE / "round30-PR190-equal-lifetime-observation/terminal-2333-complete-originals.json"
    transport_path = INTAKE / "actual-original-transport.json"
    log_path = INTAKE / "observe-114068994672-original.log"
    zip_path = INTAKE / "PR190-equal-lifetime-11650632746-original.zip"
    protected = files + [source_proof, source_path, workflow_path, driver_path, official_path,
                         transport_path, log_path, zip_path, Path(__file__).resolve()]
    before = {str(p): file_record(p) for p in protected}
    transport = jload(transport_path)
    for meta in transport["members"]:
        got = before[str(RAW / meta["path"])]
        assert all(got[k] == meta[k] for k in ["bytes", "sha256", "git_blob"])
    assert len(transport["members"]) == 13
    assert before[str(zip_path)]["bytes"] == 148586
    assert before[str(zip_path)]["sha256"] == "65a060ed65321f6916bbc3f378754bc212d44dd53bab2b34ec57e27bc091d14c"
    assert before[str(log_path)]["bytes"] == 408461
    assert before[str(log_path)]["sha256"] == "9e18d30594f13f26c36089a0dc702ee65d8bdbd575c6d4d455bf08548ce07bbf"
    assert before[str(log_path)]["git_blob"] == "993e4bb6793a5798260168262b6695ecf4630a26"
    official = jload(official_path)["raw_official"]
    run, jobs, artifacts = official["run"], official["jobs"], official["artifacts"]
    assert run["id"] == 38004163561 and run["run_attempt"] == 1
    assert run["head_sha"] == G and run["head_commit"]["tree_id"] == TREE
    assert run["status"] == "completed" and run["conclusion"] == "success"
    assert run["event"] == "pull_request" and run["path"] == WORKFLOW
    assert len(jobs["jobs"]) == 1 and jobs["jobs"][0]["id"] == 114068994672
    assert jobs["jobs"][0]["conclusion"] == "success" and jobs["jobs"][0]["run_attempt"] == 1
    assert all(s["status"] == "completed" and s["conclusion"] == "success" for s in jobs["jobs"][0]["steps"])
    assert len(artifacts["artifacts"]) == 1
    artifact = artifacts["artifacts"][0]
    assert artifact["id"] == 11650632746 and artifact["name"] == "p8-oracle-serialization-equal-lifetime-cost-38004163561-1"
    assert artifact["workflow_run"]["head_sha"] == G
    assert artifact["size_in_bytes"] == before[str(zip_path)]["bytes"]
    assert artifact["digest"] == "sha256:" + before[str(zip_path)]["sha256"]
    identity, after = jload(RAW / "identity-before.json"), jload(RAW / "identity-after.json")
    execution, observed = jload(RAW / "execution.json"), jload(RAW / "cost-observation.json")
    sb, sa = jload(RAW / "source-before.json"), jload(RAW / "source-after.json")
    assert sb == sa and (RAW / "source-before.json").read_bytes() == (RAW / "source-after.json").read_bytes()
    assert sb["source_commit"] == identity["expected_source"] == identity["source_commit"] == G
    assert sb["source_tree"] == identity["source_tree"] == TREE
    assert identity["run_id"] == "38004163561" and identity["run_attempt"] == "1"
    assert identity["argv"] == execution["argv"] == ARGV
    assert type(execution["exit_code"]) is int and execution["exit_code"] == 0 and execution["launch_error"] is None
    assert after["error"] is None
    assert all(after[k] is True for k in ["source_unchanged", "observer_inputs_unchanged", "toolchain_outputs_unchanged"])
    assert set(after["files"]) == EXPECTED_FILES - {"identity-after.json"}
    for name, meta in after["files"].items():
        assert all(meta[k] == before[str(RAW/name)][k] for k in ["bytes", "sha256"])
    assert sb["input_count"] == len(sb["inputs"]) == 1095
    assert hashlib.sha256(jbytes(sb["inputs"])).hexdigest() == sb["manifest_sha256"]
    admitted = jload(source_proof)
    assert admitted["head"] == G and admitted["tree"] == TREE and admitted["complete_inputs"] == 1095
    all_admitted = {x["path"]: x for x in admitted["files"]}
    expected_source = {k: v["sha256"] for k, v in all_admitted.items()
                       if k.startswith("crates/") or k in ["Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock"]}
    assert len(expected_source) == 1095 and expected_source == sb["inputs"]
    assert set(identity["observer_inputs"]) == {WORKFLOW, "scripts/p7_build_identity.py"}
    for path, digest in identity["observer_inputs"].items():
        assert all_admitted[path]["sha256"] == digest
    assert before[str(driver_path)]["sha256"] == identity["observer_inputs"]["scripts/p7_build_identity.py"]
    assert before[str(workflow_path)]["sha256"] == identity["observer_inputs"][WORKFLOW]
    assert before[str(workflow_path)]["git_blob"] == "89c434b3ed7eeea90600583e8837bf5a40d5117f"
    assert before[str(source_path)]["sha256"] == sb["inputs"]["crates/cc-eval/src/benchmark/oracle.rs"]
    assert before[str(source_path)]["git_blob"] == "9936bdda7293d2f27a296a6d24419bb3f2e00f7a"
    assert before[str(RAW/"Cargo.lock")]["sha256"] == identity["Cargo_lock_sha256"] == sb["inputs"]["Cargo.lock"]
    for tool in ["rustc", "cargo"]:
        b, a = RAW/(tool+"-before.txt"), RAW/(tool+"-after.txt")
        assert b.read_bytes() == a.read_bytes()
        assert before[str(b)]["sha256"] == identity["toolchain_output_sha256"][tool]
        assert b.read_text().startswith(tool+" 1.95.0 ")
    env = identity["environment"]
    assert env["CARGO_INCREMENTAL"] == "0" and env["CARGO_BUILD_JOBS"] == "2"
    assert env["RUSTFLAGS"] == env["CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS"] == ""
    assert env["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"] == "/home/runner/work/_temp/p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-target"
    stdout = (RAW/"probe.stdout").read_text()
    records, binaries, finishes = parse_stream(stdout)
    assert len(records) == 100 and records == observed["records"] and observed["record_count"] == 100
    assert observed["status"] == "observed"
    assert finishes == [{"reason": "build-finished", "success": True}]
    assert len(binaries) == 1 and binaries[0] == observed["compiler_artifact"]
    binary = binaries[0]
    assert binary["package_id"] == "path+file:///home/runner/work/codecortex/codecortex/crates/cc-eval#1.0.0"
    assert binary["manifest_path"] == "/home/runner/work/codecortex/codecortex/crates/cc-eval/Cargo.toml"
    assert binary["target"]["src_path"] == "/home/runner/work/codecortex/codecortex/crates/cc-eval/src/lib.rs"
    assert binary["target"]["kind"] == ["lib"] and binary["features"] == ["default"]
    assert binary["fresh"] is False and binary["profile"]["opt_level"] == "3"
    assert binary["profile"]["debug_assertions"] is False and binary["profile"]["test"] is True
    assert PurePosixPath(binary["executable"]).is_relative_to(PurePosixPath(env["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"]))
    assert binary["filenames"] == [binary["executable"]]
    assert re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", observed["test_executable_sha256"])
    assert type(observed["test_executable_bytes"]) is int and observed["test_executable_bytes"] > 0
    footer = re.findall(r"test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 74 filtered out; finished in ([0-9.]+)s", stdout)
    assert len(footer) == 1
    expected_slots = {(case, n) for case in CASES for n in range(20)}
    slots = []
    pairs = []
    for record in records:
        assert type(record["round"]) is int and type(record["rows"]) is int and record["rows"] == 256
        slots.append((record["case"], record["round"]))
        assert record["first"] == ("original" if record["round"] % 2 == 0 else "borrowed")
        assert all(isinstance(record[k], str) and re.fullmatch("[0-9]+", record[k]) for k in ["original_ns", "borrowed_ns"])
        assert re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", record["original_digest"])
        assert record["original_digest"] == record["borrowed_digest"] == record["reference_digest"]
        assert type(record["canonical_bytes"]) is int and record["canonical_bytes"] > 0
        assert "timing_threshold" in record and record["timing_threshold"] is None
        assert record["original_row_projection_source_blob"] == "4c7fdb879e039af164b3b10ea1491d538c69ac68"
        assert all(record[k] == v for k,v in SCOPE_STRINGS.items())
        o, b = int(record["original_ns"]), int(record["borrowed_ns"])
        pairs.append({"case":record["case"],"round":record["round"],"first":record["first"],
                      "original_ns":o,"borrowed_ns":b,"borrowed_over_original":b/o if o else None,
                      "canonical_bytes":record["canonical_bytes"],"reference_digest":record["reference_digest"]})
    assert len(set(slots)) == 100 and set(slots) == expected_slots
    # Compare original full Actions log to the original standalone stdout records,
    # after removing only GitHub's timestamp prefix; do not reconstruct product output.
    log = log_path.read_text()
    clean_log = "\n".join(re.sub(r"^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT[0-9:.]+Z ", "", line) for line in log.splitlines())
    log_records, log_binaries, log_finishes = parse_stream(clean_log)
    assert log_records == records and log_binaries == binaries and log_finishes == finishes
    assert "[command]/usr/bin/git checkout --progress --force "+G in clean_log
    assert "[command]/usr/bin/git log -1 --format=%H\n"+G in clean_log
    assert re.search(r"test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;", clean_log)
    for line in (RAW/"probe.stderr").read_text().splitlines():
        if line.strip():
            assert line in clean_log, "Original stderr line absent from full job log"
    case_results = {}
    for case in CASES:
        rows = [r for r in pairs if r["case"] == case]
        assert len(rows) == 20
        assert len({r["reference_digest"] for r in rows}) == 1
        assert len({r["canonical_bytes"] for r in rows}) == 1
        strata = {first: [r for r in rows if r["first"] == first] for first in ["original","borrowed"]}
        assert all(len(group) == 10 for group in strata.values())
        case_results[case] = {"all_pairs":paired_summary(rows),
                              "by_first":{first:paired_summary(group) for first,group in strata.items()},
                              "pairs_original_order":rows}
    slower = [r for r in pairs if r["borrowed_ns"] > r["original_ns"]]
    finished = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    after_files = {str(p): file_record(p) for p in protected}
    assert before == after_files
    output = {
        "schema":"pr190-equal-lifetime-independent-original-acceptance-v1",
        "reviewer":"/root/pr_triage","status":"accepted_scoped_finite_diagnostic_originals",
        "source_G":G,"source_tree":TREE,"run_id":38004163561,"run_attempt":1,"job_id":114068994672,
        "artifact_id":11650632746,"observed_review_started_utc":started,"observed_review_finished_utc":finished,
        "protocol":"Unmodified original workflow contract; no added performance threshold.",
        "transport":{"root_crc_and_safe_extraction_reused":True,"crc_or_extract_repeated":False,
                     "all_13_member_bytes_sha_git_oid_equal_root_transport":True,
                     "zip":before[str(zip_path)],"full_original_log":before[str(log_path)]},
        "identity":{"source_before_after_exact":True,"all_1095_hashes_equal_previously_Git_bound_admitted_source":True,
                    "manifest_sha256":sb["manifest_sha256"],"observer_inputs":identity["observer_inputs"],
                    "toolchain_outputs_unchanged":True,"Cargo_lock_sha256":identity["Cargo_lock_sha256"],
                    "current_full_source_checkout_recreated":False,"source_snapshot_locally_executed":False,
                    "original_identity_after_inventory":len(after["files"]),"protected_before_after_unchanged":True},
        "actual_execution":{"original_exit_code":execution["exit_code"],"launch_error":execution["launch_error"],
                            "argv":ARGV,"started_utc":execution["started_utc"],"finished_utc":execution["finished_utc"],
                            "compilation_inclusive_wall_ns":execution["wall_ns"],"libtest":footer,
                            "passed":1,"failed":0,"ignored":0,"filtered":74,"full_log_records_exact":True},
        "producer":{"compiler_artifact":binary,"test_executable_sha256":observed["test_executable_sha256"],
                    "test_executable_bytes":observed["test_executable_bytes"],
                    "scope":"Actual Cargo producer and producer-recorded post-execution ELF hash/size; ELF bytes not in original ZIP, no independent local ELF rehash or execution."},
        "coverage":{"unique_pairs":100,"cases":5,"rounds_per_case":20,"rows_per_side":256,
                    "order_per_case":{"original_first":10,"borrowed_first":10},
                    "all_three_digests_equal":True,
                    "full_row_equality":"Original compiled probe performs full Vec<String> equality against shared reference before digest. Original standalone full row bytes are not emitted; independent reader corroborates native successful assertion and all three recorded digests."},
        "statistics_method":{"ratio":"borrowed_ns / original_ns; below 1 means borrowed side took less time in that pair.",
                             "quartiles":"Median of sorted lower/upper halves; all pairs and sorted distributions retained.",
                             "no_filtering":True,"no_case_pooling":True,"no_p_value_or_stable_tail_claim":True,
                             "no_new_acceptance_threshold":True,"raw_timing_units":"integer nanoseconds"},
        "by_case":case_results,"all_slower_pairs_retained":slower,
        "evidence_limits":["Single hosted process/compiler/source and five constructed 256-row cases.",
                           "Within-case rounds are repeated dependent observations, not independent repositories or machines.",
                           "Timers include SQLite SELECT traversal, serialization and output retention; they cannot separate those costs.",
                           "Output verification/hash/drop occur outside each timer; original baseline reuses its Map.",
                           "Shared reference remains live equally; previous large output is dropped before next side. Residual small digest, allocator/cache/order history are not reset.",
                           "No claim about full 100k workload, current main a406, full-scale end-to-end speed, release approval, or original TODO completion.",
                           "Old retained-pair v1 result remains separate, unchanged, and not replaced by this source/run.",
                           "Original per-row output bytes and ELF bytes are not archived by this protocol; their runtime native checks/producer receipts are accepted at that explicit scope."],
        "task_credit":0,"scale_samples_added":0,
        "input_inventory_before":before,"input_inventory_after":after_files,
    }
    write_new("independent-original-acceptance-and-paired-analysis.json", output)
    print(json.dumps({"status":output["status"],"pairs":100,"all_inputs_unchanged":True,
                      "by_case":{c:{"median_ratio":v["all_pairs"]["ratio_borrowed_over_original"]["median"],
                                   "faster":v["all_pairs"]["borrowed_faster"],
                                   "slower":v["all_pairs"]["borrowed_slower"],
                                   "original_first_median":v["by_first"]["original"]["ratio_borrowed_over_original"]["median"],
                                   "borrowed_first_median":v["by_first"]["borrowed"]["ratio_borrowed_over_original"]["median"]}
                                 for c,v in case_results.items()}}, sort_keys=True))
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
